answer: A reputation stake that vests over time resists Sybils: each agent must lock a deposit and build a verifiable work history before its votes count fully. A newcomer cannot simply wander in, spin up thousands of identities, and sway a market, because every identity needs its own stake and time to mature. Like a sonnet, the rules are strict and public; like a willow, a genuine reputation bends under scrutiny but does not break, while cheap copies wither when challenged and forfeit their stake.
